Best Roofing for Bungalows in Toronto: A Complete Homeowner’s Guide

‍

Bungalows are one of the most common home styles in Toronto. Built mostly between the 1920s and 1970s, these homes are known for their charm, wide roof surfaces, and low-slope designs.

But when it comes to roofing, bungalows come with unique challenges especially in Toronto’s harsh climate.

If you’re wondering what roofing material works best for a Toronto bungalow, this guide will help you make a confident, long-term decision.

‍

‍

Why Roofing Choice Matters for Toronto Bungalows

Unlike two-storey homes, bungalows have:

  • Large roof surface areas
  • Lower roof pitch
  • Higher exposure to snow, ice, and moisture
  • Older roof framing in many cases

Toronto winters demand roofing systems that can handle snow load, ice dams, and freeze-thaw cycles something not all roofing materials are built for.

Best Roofing Options for Bungalows in Toronto

1️⃣ Metal Roofing (Best Overall Choice)

Metal roofing is widely considered the best roofing solution for bungalows in Toronto  especially for homeowners looking for durability and long-term value.

👉 Learn more about metal roofing solutions from Rudan Roofing and how they’re designed for Ontario weather.

Why metal roofing works so well for bungalows:

  • Snow sheds easily, reducing ice dams
  • Lightweight  ideal for older bungalow structures
  • 40–70 year lifespan
  • Excellent performance in freeze-thaw conditions
  • Minimal maintenance

Popular metal roofing styles for bungalows include:

  • Modular metal roof tiles
  • Steel shingle systems
  • Standing seam metal roofing

You can explore available profiles and finishes in the Rudan Roofing product catalog

‍

2️⃣ Architectural Asphalt Shingles (Budget Option)

Architectural shingles remain common across Toronto due to lower upfront cost.

However, on bungalows they often struggle with:

  • Ice dam formation
  • Shorter lifespan (15–25 years)
  • Higher long-term maintenance

This option is better suited for short-term ownership rather than permanent homes.

‍

Why Metal Roofing Outperforms Shingles on Bungalows

‍

Toronto bungalow homeowners often find that metal roofing costs less over time, despite higher initial investment.

Energy Efficiency Benefits for Bungalow Homes

Bungalows lose more heat through the roof due to their wide footprint. Metal roofing:

  • Reflects summer heat
  • Works efficiently with attic insulation
  • Helps lower cooling costs
  • Improves year-round comfort

This makes it an excellent option for energy-conscious homeowners.

Common Roofing Problems in Toronto Bungalows

  • Ice dams along wide eaves
  • Leaks near chimneys and valleys
  • Shingle blow-offs during storms
  • Moisture buildup under aging shingles

Many of these issues are solved by switching to properly installed metal roofing systems.

‍

‍

Do You Need a Permit for Bungalow Roofing in Toronto?

In most cases:

  • Replacing shingles with shingles → No permit
  • Switching from shingles to metal → May require confirmation

Working with an experienced supplier like Rudan Roofing helps ensure compliance with local requirements.

How Long Does Bungalow Roof Installation Take?

  • Shingle roof: 2–4 days
  • Metal roofing system: 3–6 days

While metal roofing takes slightly longer to install, it significantly reduces future repairs and replacements.

‍

‍

Is Metal Roofing Worth It for Toronto Bungalows?

For most homeowners - yes.

Metal roofing is ideal if you:

  • Own an older bungalow
  • Plan to stay long-term
  • Want minimal maintenance
  • Want protection from snow & ice

For organized and efficient installation, many homeowners choose Roof-On-A-Pallet systems by Rudan Roofing, which streamline materials and reduce installation errors.
